title: A small board with a track, two vias and a zone
how: Counted in the file: 5 layers (2 copper); 1 footprint with 3 pads; 2 components (R1, R2) that use it = 6 placed pads; 1 net; 2 pad nets (pad 1 of each component);
1 track of 1 piece; 2 vias; 1 zone; the outline has 4 points; no silkscreen.
The board is consistent: every reference is there and the copper stack names the two copper layers.
